svg.aria-label: A stop in seven steps: note the containers to bring back, your hooks, your units, Docker's daemon stopping every container, Podman's containers, sync, then record how it went. Under them, stop_limit, 300 seconds, as a row of cells: the demo's stop lit 23 seconds of it; then WSL ends what is left.
